description: Inspect branches, tags, and their protection rules. Actions: list_branches, get_branch, list_tags, get_tag, list_protected_branches, get_protected_branch, list_protected_tags (protection details and access levels). Related: manage_ref to create/delete/protect, browse_commits for commit history.

action.description: Action to perform: list_branches, get_branch, list_tags, get_tag, list_protected_branches, get_protected_branch, list_protected_tags

branch.description: Branch name (URL-encoded if contains slashes) Required for 'get_branch' action(s).

name.description: Branch name or wildcard pattern (e.g., 'main', 'release-*') Required for 'get_protected_branch' action(s).

order_by.description: Sort by field (default: updated) Required for 'list_tags' action(s).

per_page.description: Number of items per page (max 100) Required for 'list_branches', 'list_tags', 'list_protected_branches', 'list_protected_tags' action(s).

regex.description: Filter branches by regex pattern Required for 'list_branches' action(s).

search.description: Filter branches by name (supports wildcards) Required for 'list_branches', 'list_tags', 'list_protected_branches' action(s).

sort.description: Sort direction (default: desc) Required for 'list_tags' action(s).

tag_name.description: Tag name (URL-encoded if contains special characters) Required for 'get_tag' action(s).

name: browse_refs
